claims.quote: To restore FOXG1 in neurons, we developed AAV vectors expressing human FOXG1 under neuron-specific promoters.

claims.object_text: normalized OPC accumulation, enhanced myelination, and corrected hippocampal structural abnormalities
claims.quote: Neonatal administration of these vectors normalized oligodendrocyte precursor cell (OPC) accumulation, enhanced myelination, and corrected hippocampal structural abnormalities in Foxg1 conditional heterozygous mice.
the patient-specific W300X heterozygous model, which combines FOXG1 loss-of-function with a toxic truncated protein

neuron-restricted AAV-FOXG1 delivery produced substantial rescue even in this high-bar model, suppressing OPC overaccumulation, restoring myelination, and progressively improving dentate gyrus morphology, with benefits persisting into adulthood.
Moreover, adolescent administration remained highly effective, rescuing myelination, axonal bundle thickness, and microglial activation.
These findings identify neuronal FOXG1 as a master regulator of neuron-glia interactions
